reason: A dsh skill plugin for traditional Chinese culture consultation, combining local deterministic calculations, AI-agent routing, layered explanations, and a visualization dashboard.

summaries.zh: 一个在 dsh 对话中提供中华传统文化咨询的技能插件，包含本地排盘与推演工具、分层解释和可视化 Dashboard。
summaries.en: A dsh skill plugin for Chinese traditional-culture consultation with local calculation tools, layered explanations, and a visualization dashboard.

capabilities: Provides AI-agent routing for traditional Chinese culture consultation workflows
Performs local deterministic calculations for systems including bazi, ziwei doushu, I Ching methods, feng shui, calendars, and body constitution questionnaires
Provides a local dashboard for viewing and modifying inputs and results
Produces cultural interpretations and practical suggestions for topics including health, career, relationships, and living spaces
